text:
emma: Quick design sync  thinking about group status badges for the preflight probes (host groups / port groups). Idea: a single badge per group showing counts + severity icon. mock: https://www.figma.com/file/zzz/group-badges (frame: badges). thoughts? :badge:
luca: Nice for scan density. need rules for severity: what counts as amber vs red? intermittent failures should be amber, hard failures red. Also suggest tooltip with "last 3 results".
priya: Accessibility: badge must be keyboard focusable and announce summary via aria-live or role=status. Suggest text: "4 checks: 3 ok, 1 intermittent". Avoid announcing each probe.
ben: Copy nit: prefer "checks" over "probes" in UI copy (matches console elsewhere). Banner: "Network checks  3 of 4 passing".
aria: Repair affordance: a grouped "Quick fix" dropdown that shows context-aware actions: "Retry group", "Run diagnostic", "Open host logs". Each action needs accessible labels and a confirmation toast.
priya: If we add "Open host logs" the link must be behind auth and not pasteable by default. For clipboard safety, avoid including signed URLs in copied text.
luca: Visual: badge should have small numeric pill and an icon. on hover show breakdown. on mobile expand the group card to show breakdown, not tooltip.
ben: UX microcopy for badge tooltip: "3 passing \u2014 1 flaky (last 3: ok, ok, fail)". For the group action label use verbs: "Retry group" / "Run diagnostics" / "Copy summary".
priya: Keyboard flow: tab to badge -> Enter opens menu -> menu is arrow-key navigable -> choose action -> focus returns to badge. Escape closes menu. Announce menu open: "Group actions menu opened" via aria-live.
emma: Edge case: when group auto-collapses, we still need a persistent failure strip visible at top. design shows a tiny failure pill pinned to the step header. is that ok?
aria: Yes, and it should be first in DOM for screen readers. Also add `aria-describedby` on header pointing to failure summary.
luca: Performance: avoid rendering full detail for collapsed groups. render placeholders with fixed heights to avoid layout shifts. design will include 1x, 2x example heights.
ben: Small copy alignment: use hyphenated counts: "Network checks  3 of 4 passing" (not percent). Keep consistent across product.
priya: Accessibility checklist: role=status on summary, keyboard menu, focus trapping in expanded view, toast announcements for actions, contrast >=4.5:1 for any dim text. I'll add to the a11y doc.
emma: I'll update figma with badge states (all-ok, flaky, fail) + menu mock and copy strings. tagging @luca @priya @aria for sign-off. :sparkles:
